applyFailed: Failed to set the cover image: {msg}
undoUnavailable: No previous cover image to restore
selectHint: Click a photo to use it as the cover of this document
fallbackNotice: No results for "{query}", fell back to "{fallback}"
emptyResultsDesc: Try another keyword, or adjust the fallback query in the settings.
notConfiguredTitle: Unsplash Access Key is not configured yet
notConfiguredDesc: The plugin needs an Unsplash Access Key to search photos. A free demo key is enough (50 requests/hour).
settingAccessKeyTip: Create an app in the Unsplash developer dashboard to get one. Note: the key is stored in plain text inside this workspace's plugin data (synced to the cloud), so prefer a low-privilege demo key.
settingSaveLocal: Download the picked photo into local assets
settingSaveLocalTip: Off by default: the photo is referenced from Unsplash's own CDN, which complies with the Unsplash API guidelines and costs no disk space. When enabled, the photo is downloaded and written into data/assets/ through the SiYuan kernel API.
settingSaveLocalOrphanTip: When enabled, repeatedly changing covers leaves unreferenced files behind. Use SiYuan's built-in unused-asset cleanup from time to time.
settingAutoExtract: Search with the document title automatically
settingAutoExtractTip: Tokenizes the title with the native Intl.Segmenter; no third-party dictionary is bundled.
settingFallbackQueryTip: Used when the title yields no usable keyword, for example nature landscape. Separate multiple words with spaces.
settingUseProxy: Send requests through the SiYuan kernel proxy
settingUseProxyTip: Enable this when Unsplash is unreachable directly. Both API calls and image downloads go through the kernel's /api/network/forwardProxy.
errorNoAccessKey: No Unsplash Access Key configured yet. Please fill it in the plugin settings.
errorInvalidKey: The Access Key is invalid (401). Please check it in the plugin settings.
errorRateLimit: The Unsplash hourly request limit has been reached (50 requests/hour for demo keys). Please try again later.
errorForbidden: This Access Key is not allowed to use that endpoint (403).
errorNetwork: Network request failed, possibly due to a restricted network. Enable "Send requests through the SiYuan kernel proxy" in the plugin settings and retry.
errorTooLarge: The image is too large for the kernel proxy to forward (over 32 MiB). Lower the cover width and retry.
errorUploadFailed: Failed to save the image locally: {msg}
warnLocalSaveFallback: Saving locally failed, fell back to the remote image URL: {msg}
